reviewMethod: Saved full native sequence, actual calls/jobs, stable actor IDs, full20Hz telemetry and all22trajectory plots for all24 designed runs. Descriptive screens are post-selection checks, not football truth or fitted acceptance filters. No engine execution, modifications or additional sims.

interpretation.blocking: Nine planned second-level nonrealizations are a repeated access question, not nine established bad blocks. All four IZ, threeWZ and twoDuo; A027 usefulWZblock is deliberately excluded. A013 already loses to an interior defender. Keeper loads, defender counters, departure constraints and safe alternative fits remain competing causes.
interpretation.coverage: All8 Quarters MOD run exposures have a transient FS man:X/request reversal after run recognition, persisting when a recorded RB picture confirms carrying=true. Source branch is established. Achieved FS velocity remains inward at 2.00; a receiver-named rob job alone is not evidence of a failure. Consequence is not counterfactually measured.
interpretation.negativeFindings: All 24 handoffs complete and all 24 end in tackles. No sampled RB speed<1yd/s after handoff but before first carrier contactevent. Three offensive teammatecontacts≥1yd/s closing; onlyA028RT/Y1.50 ispre-firstcontact. Thus thispaneldoesnotidentify recurrentprecontactrunnerfreezes or teammatejams. These screens cannot exclude other traffic/control defects.
interpretation.opposingEvidence: A006/A042Duo create useful early climbs/creases and23.25/9.99ydruns; A028ordinaryPower creates an actual kickfit and4.50yd; A027WZ creates an actual Y/LB_M block/control/load. Preserve these. DE_Swins inA026/A040, DT_SwinsA013/A016 and multi-defenderfinishes are not automatically faults.

limitations: Balanced fixedcallpanel frequencies are not ordinary gamecaller or league rates; four frozen lineups and one seedpercall.
No before/after intervention, so no counterfactual yardage/causal ranking. No physics law defect inferred from falls, wraps or blocking losses.
Existing frame t labels enclosing tick afterphysics; native bins are not continuous contact instants. Original events retained.
Full recorded intents are post-engagement/bond/spacing; read/intent cause cannot be assigned from them alone. Recorded see samples are available calls, not callsite labels.
Full telemetry rounds body state; replay positions rounded0.1yd. No derivatives from those positions used for claims here.
HoldingA004 retained as event; standalone outcome remains physicalsnap result, not game-wrapper penalty enforcement.
Descriptive 1yd/s carrier-speed/contact screens were inspected after frozenpanel selection; they are transparent triage proxies, not preregistered football validation thresholds.
